commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) gets a yellow card. The referee Jesus Manzano made the right call.
90+3' 2 - 1 Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90+1' Confusion on the bench but it seems Hansi Flick has received a second yellow card from the ref and is walking off!
90+1' Referee Jesus Manzano has finally had enough of Hansi Flick and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+1' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
88' The statistic for corner kicks – 11:5.
85' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Paulo Gazzaniga reads it well and stops the effort.
84' The foul by Alex Moreno (Girona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Manzano.
82' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
82' A substitution has been made. Marc Casado goes off and Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) comes on.
81' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
79' Arnau Martinez is being substituted because of an injury. Michel sends Lass Kourouma (Girona) on the pitch.
78' Arnau Martinez (Girona) picks up an injury.
76' That's the end of the game for Alejandro Balde, who is replaced by Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
75' A yellow card for a tackle by Cristhian Stuani (Girona). Jesus Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
73' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
71' 25:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' Michel prepares a substitution. Vladyslav Vanat is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
68' Joel Roca goes off the pitch and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes on.
67' Joel Roca (Girona) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Wojciech Szczesny has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
66' Barcelona take a short corner kick.

66' What a wasted opportunity by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
65' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
65' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
64' Substitution. Lamine Yamal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedri leaves the pitch and Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) comes on.
63' Michel has decided to make a change. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) replaces Bryan Gil.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Portu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
61' The Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Jesus Manzano rules it out for a foul.
61' Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
59' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
58' Daley Blind (Girona) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Barcelona are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
58' Bryan Gil (Girona) launches a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny is alert to thwart the effort.
57' Portu (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
57' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
55' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) meets the corner with a powerful well-placed header that beats the keeper, but the close-range effort is superbly blocked on the goal line by a defender. Unlucky!
55' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
54' A snap shot by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga produces a good save to thwart him.
52' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
50' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Bryan Gil (Girona) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
48' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes a comfortable save.
47' A corner kick by Barcelona is thwarted by the well prepared Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona).
47' Pedri (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) and Toni Fernandez is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Alex Moreno (Girona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+1' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle after Marc Casado (Barcelona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
43' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
43' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
41' Axel Witsel (Girona) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
39' Bryan Gil (Girona) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
39' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
38' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Barcelona comes to nothing.
37' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
36' The possession of the ball – 72:28.
34' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
30' OFF THE BAR! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) strikes a brilliant shot towards goal from the free kick, but his effort rattles the crossbar.
30' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

26' Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a great save to deny Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:3.
25' Portu (Girona) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the right post.
23' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Wojciech Szczesny easily deals with the threat.
20' What a GOAL! The lofted pass into the box is expertly and acrobatically dispatched into the net by Axel Witsel (Girona). 1:1.
20' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
19' Bryan Gil (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:0.

13' 1 - 0 Pedri (Barcelona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Paulo Gazzaniga with a precise strike which bounces off the bottom of the right post and into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
10' Pedri (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
7' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
5' Fine play by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post.
4' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) fires the resulting free kick on goal from a medium range, but sees his shot saved by the goalkeeper.
3' Bryan Gil (Girona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' The first half has just begun.
Girona will kick the game off.
Jesus Manzano will officiate today.
